children.name: Motion 01
children.text: 0.0 – 1.4 s · The gold point fades up from absolute black and breathes once (scale 0.6 → 1.0). Nothing else exists. The counter starts ticking from 000.

children.name: Motion 02
children.text: 1.4 – 3.2 s · Light condenses into a hairline ring that spins up out of a faint spiral haze; the dial fills tick by tick with the counter; stars ignite from the edges inward.

children.name: Motion 03
children.text: 3.2 – 4.6 s · The ring splits into six blades and widens like an aperture, the point dissolves into the planet's limb behind it, NOUMENA fades in. Click or scroll dives through the lens into the Hero.

children.text: A 6 px ring, 1 px silver. Trails the pointer by 80 ms, like a probe in thin air.

children.name: Caption C3

children.name: Lead
children.text: Transitions are not effects. Each one is the same camera travelling outward from the Origin — drawn here as states, so every cut can be built frame by frame.
